purpose: Define a bounded, reproducible official-source fallback without downloading either corpus in R5.

common_acquisition_rules.manifest_before_transfer: Create and review a candidate manifest containing source revision, provider object IDs, candidate host/day/run/topic IDs, and estimated byte counts before any data transfer.

checksum_method.per_object: SHA-256 over the exact downloaded bytes; preserve provider filename/object ID and byte length.
checksum_method.manifest: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) of the ordered object records and selection rule.
checksum_method.post_extract: SHA-256 every extracted file and retain an immutable sorted checksum list; do not trust filenames alone.
checksum_method.resume_rule: A failed or partial transfer is quarantined and never admitted by size alone.

common_acquisition_rules.normalization_boundary: Decode only after integrity verification. Map source records to the R3 canonical entity/event contract, then invoke provx-adapted-live-v1. Ground-truth, labels, analyst annotations, playbook/action IDs, and source identifiers remain manifest metadata and never enter x.
common_acquisition_rules.license_and_release: Both official READMEs describe a public-domain/public-release, as-is distribution with no warranty; the external Google Drive/provider terms and any access authorization must be rechecked and recorded at acquisition. Preserve the source NOTICE/README files.
common_acquisition_rules.formal_exclusion: No FA1B2de playbook/action, label, outcome, or derived record may be acquired or admitted through this design.

official_facts.documented_scale: approximately one terabyte compressed JSON-compatible data; approximately 500 collected hosts from a two-week evaluation
official_facts.release_terms: README states public domain and Distribution A: approved for public release, distribution unlimited; data is as-is and without warranty.
official_facts.labels: OpTCRedTeamGroundTruth.pdf and associated red-team documentation; labels are partition metadata only.
official_facts.known_quality_constraint: Apply the pinned errata, including duplicate-process and malformed-record handling, before candidate admission.

bounded_selection.candidate_unit: host_id + UTC calendar day + source run/file
bounded_selection.eligible_host: Host has at least two complete benign-only UTC days before red-team activity and at least one complete UTC day with a ground-truth-overlapping red-team interval; all selected files pass errata checks and required process/file/socket coverage.
bounded_selection.host_order: Before de-identification, sort the provider's canonical hostname bytes in UTF-8 order and select the first 8 eligible hosts; then apply the frozen keyed de-identification mapping and persist its mapping hash. If fewer than 8 qualify, stop and request a smaller/different subset rather than silently relaxing criteria.
bounded_selection.day_order: For each selected host, select the two earliest complete benign-only UTC days and the earliest complete ground-truth-overlap day.
bounded_selection.window_rule: Within each selected host/day/run, select the earliest contiguous 3600-second UTC window whose record-count/loss audit passes. For the overlap day, the window must intersect at least one documented red-team interval; retain the full window as one indivisible group.
bounded_selection.expected_size: Subset size is not discoverable from official documentation before manifesting; enforce a hard ceiling of 20 GiB compressed transfer and 50 GiB expanded storage. Exceeding either ceiling stops acquisition and invokes REQUEST_SMALLER_OR_DIFFERENT_SUBSET.
bounded_selection.positive_negative_roles: The two benign windows are negative/background groups; the overlap window is positive only for records aligned to the independently manifested ground-truth interval. Unaligned background remains negative and is not relabeled by proximity.
bounded_selection.selection_failure: Missing ground truth, incomplete windows, or insufficient qualifying hosts causes a blocked subset, not substitution of arbitrary hosts/days.

normalization_requirements: Canonicalize eCAR event/object/action tokens to the R3 event classes; retain unknown tokens as other and count them.
Map process identity from actorID/pid/ppid/start-time evidence, file identity from objectID/path/hash, and socket identity/endpoints from documented properties; do not use red-team fields.
Normalize timestamp_ms to UTC epoch milliseconds and construct causal edges only from collector-visible actor/object relationships.
De-identify host/path/user identifiers with a versioned keyed mapping before split assignment; the mapping key is not a feature.
Record rejected records, clipping, unknown fields, duplicate coalescing, node_map, edge_map, and raw hashes in the run manifest.

official_facts.documented_scale: Exact release size is not stated in the pinned README; files are hosted externally because of their size.
official_facts.release_terms: README-E3 states public domain/public release, as-is and without warranty; confirm provider terms and authorization at acquisition.
official_facts.labels: ground truth/tc_ground_truth_report_e3_update.pdf and ACT/engagement annotations; labels remain partition metadata.
official_facts.schema: CDM Avro records with performer-specific data trees; preserve CDM schema revision and parser version.

bounded_selection.candidate_unit: performer + good topic + engagement run + host
bounded_selection.eligible_topic: Use only the official README-E3 'Topics containing good data' list; for each of the five named performers, sort eligible topic names by UTF-8 byte order and select the first topic.
bounded_selection.window_rule: For each selected topic, select the earliest complete contiguous 3600-second benign window and the earliest complete contiguous 3600-second window intersecting a documented ground-truth activity interval. Keep each window and performer/topic/host/run group indivisible.
bounded_selection.expected_size: Not discoverable before an official file manifest; enforce a hard ceiling of 10 GiB compressed transfer and 30 GiB expanded storage. Exceeding either ceiling stops acquisition and invokes REQUEST_SMALLER_OR_DIFFERENT_SUBSET.
bounded_selection.positive_negative_roles: The benign window is background/negative. The ground-truth-overlap window contributes positive labels only where the independent ground-truth alignment says so; remaining records retain their declared background role.
bounded_selection.selection_failure: If a performer has no complete good topic/window or ground-truth alignment, do not replace it with an unlisted topic; stop and request a smaller/different subset.

normalization_requirements: Decode Avro/CDM with the pinned schema and parser version; preserve performer/topic/source IDs in metadata only.
Map process, file, socket/system-component entities and causal interactions to the R3 canonical entity/event contract; version every performer-specific mapping.
Normalize timestamps to UTC epoch milliseconds, resolve identities deterministically, and retain unknown/invalid record counters rather than coercing silently.
Apply the same de-identification, node/edge ordering, duplicate policy, and 32D encoder hash as local Track-L traces.
Keep ground-truth report joins outside feature construction and record exact alignment windows and label provenance in the manifest.

acquisition_stop_conditions: provider object identity or source revision cannot be pinned
per-object or extracted-file SHA-256 verification fails
selection criteria cannot be satisfied without post-hoc relaxation
any overlap with FA1B2de or its 1796 raw actions is detected
normalization cannot produce finite x[*,32] under provx-adapted-live-v1
